posts.author: Shireus
posts.body:
Hi,I'm planning to start a project in RPG Maker XP and I wish it had a Japanese aesthetic
I tried to search on my own but I can't tell if a tileset is for one version of the program or another, and therefore incompatible with XP (if this makes sense)
I would appreciate some help

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Well you're looking for tiles that are 32x32 pixels (same in XP, VX and VX Ace). If you're unsure, just open the file and measure it in GIMP. Also, it helps if you tell if you're trying to find modern or old Japanese themed tilesets.

Kinda old style,is for a Pokémon fangame,if all RPG Maker versions use the same size, then even if the tileset says it's made for one version,i can still use it on XP?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Not all RPG Makers use same size, the ones I listed do. If you use stuff from some version you have to own that version. But you can use stuff that people have made from scratch in any version (if they allow it in their credits). For your original question, here's a list (for ACE, but same size):
Japanese Themed Resources

posts.author: slimmmeiske2
posts.body:
Ace and VX tilesets do use the same grid size, but are differently formatted from XP's, so you'd need to know how to reformat them.
There are some XP Japanese tilesets out there:
Hyouburogu
A Country of Sunrise
Sithjester
